summary: Puerto Vallarta is a stunning Pacific coastal destination where colonial charm meets modern resort luxury, offering world-class beaches, vibrant street culture, and exceptional culinary experiences. Nestled between the Sierra Madre mountains and the Bay of Banderas, this Mexican gem combines adventure opportunities with laid-back beach relaxation and world-renowned street art.

restaurants.name: Mariscos Playa Hermosa
restaurants.description: Beachfront seafood shack serving fresh ceviche, fish tacos, and grilled whole fish with ocean views.

restaurants.name: Café des Artistes
restaurants.description: Award-winning restaurant in the Riviera district featuring French-Mexican fusion cuisine and an extensive wine collection.

restaurants.name: Andres Rodríguez
restaurants.description: Intimate fine dining establishment showcasing contemporary Mexican cuisine with seasonal ingredients and creative presentations.

restaurants.name: Tótem
restaurants.description: Trendy restaurant combining indigenous Mexican flavors with modern cooking techniques in a sophisticated setting.

restaurants.name: El Tocino
restaurants.description: Popular local spot famous for birria tacos, chiles rellenos, and traditional Mexican breakfast dishes.

restaurants.name: Archie's Wok
restaurants.description: Long-standing fusion restaurant combining Asian cuisine with fresh seafood in a casual, colorful atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Barrio Café
restaurants.description: Charming neighborhood café serving authentic street food, tacos, and traditional Mexican snacks with local flavor.

restaurants.name: Señor Charro's
restaurants.description: Family-friendly Mexican restaurant specializing in grilled meats, fresh seafood, and traditional regional dishes.

restaurants.name: Freddy's Tucan
restaurants.description: Oceanfront restaurant with spectacular sunset views, featuring fresh fish, lobster, and creative seafood preparations.

restaurants.name: La Leche
restaurants.description: Farm-to-table restaurant emphasizing organic vegetables and locally-sourced ingredients in vegetarian and seafood dishes.

restaurants.name: River Cafe
restaurants.description: Casual riverside eatery offering breakfast, lunch, and light fare with river views and relaxed atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Cocina Comida Mexicana
restaurants.description: Traditional Mexican kitchen serving authentic regional recipes passed down through generations with warm hospitality.

activities.name: Zip-lining through the Canopy
activities.description: Soar through the lush jungle canopy with panoramic views of the Bay of Banderas. Multiple lines offer varying difficulty levels and an adrenaline-pumping experience.

activities.name: Marino Vallarta Dolphin Encounter
activities.description: Swim with dolphins in a natural lagoon setting or observe them from a boat tour. Educational and memorable experience with marine biologists.

activities.name: Sayulita Beach Day Trip
activities.description: Visit the bohemian beach town of Sayulita featuring colorful murals, excellent surf breaks, and fresh seafood restaurants just 40 minutes away.

activities.name: Hiking to Destiladeras and Playa Las Gemelas
activities.description: Trek through coastal trails to secluded beaches with dramatic cliff views and pristine turquoise waters. Difficulty varies by trail selection.

activities.name: Night Fishing Excursion
activities.description: Embark on an evening fishing adventure in the Pacific, learning traditional fishing techniques while experiencing the sunset and starlit ocean.

activities.name: Malecón Boardwalk Stroll and Street Art Tour
activities.description: Explore the iconic oceanfront promenade featuring local artist murals, street performers, colonial architecture, and sunset views. Guides available for curated tours.

activities.name: Yelapa Waterfalls and Village Tour
activities.description: Boat-accessible village featuring cascading waterfalls, jungle hikes, and pristine beaches accessible only by water. Bohemian atmosphere with local restaurants.

activities.name: Scuba Diving and Snorkeling
activities.description: Explore the Banderas Bay marine life including tropical fish, sea turtles, and coral formations. Multiple dive sites suitable for all certification levels.

activities.name: Vallarta Botanical Gardens Visit
activities.description: Wander through 20 acres of exotic plants, water features, and sculptures showcasing regional flora and botanical artistry in a peaceful setting.

activities.name: Old Town Puerto Vallarta Walking Tour
activities.description: Discover colonial architecture, hidden plazas, local galleries, and authentic restaurants in the charming historic district with cobblestone streets.

activities.name: Sunset Catamaran Cruise
activities.description: Sail through the Bay of Banderas on a luxury catamaran with drinks, snacks, and entertainment while watching the sun descend into the Pacific.

activities.name: Beginner Surf Lesson at Playa Los Camarones
activities.description: Learn surfing from experienced instructors on beginner-friendly waves. Equipment provided and lessons tailored to individual skill levels.

spots.name: Malecón at Sunrise
spots.description: Golden light illuminates the iconic boardwalk sculptures and colonial architecture with the Bay of Banderas as backdrop.

spots.name: Street Art Murals in Vallarta Centro
spots.description: Vibrant, colorful murals covering building facades throughout the historic district create striking compositions with perfect lighting angles.

spots.name: Viewpoint at El Vertigo
spots.description: Dramatic coastal cliffs with crashing waves below and the town sprawling across the hillside provide panoramic landscape opportunities.

spots.name: Playa Yelapa Waterfall
spots.description: Cascading waterfall framed by jungle vegetation with emerald pools creates ethereal natural photography with moisture-friendly challenges.

spots.name: Sunset from Playa Destiladeras
spots.description: Dramatic cliff formations frame golden and orange skies as the sun sinks into the Pacific Ocean.

spots.name: Market Scene at Mercado Municipal
spots.description: Colorful produce, fresh seafood, and local vendor interactions create vibrant street and cultural photography opportunities.

spots.name: Cathedral Basilica Details
spots.description: Intricate architectural details, crown-shaped towers, and colonial facade elements offer excellent detail and composition opportunities.

spots.name: Night Scene at Malecón
spots.description: String lights, local performers, and illuminated fountains create dynamic nighttime street photography with atmospheric city glow.

spots.name: Pelican Wildlife at Flamingos Beach
spots.description: Diving pelicans, cormorants, and other seabirds provide excellent wildlife photography action shots with dynamic movement.

spots.name: Puerto Vallarta Pier Reflections
spots.description: The wooden pier creates leading lines with reflections in calm morning waters and dramatic sunset backlit opportunities.

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for sweeping coastal landscapes and architecture
70-200mm telephoto for wildlife, distant pelicans, and compressed cityscapes
35-85mm portrait lens for street photography and detail work
24mm prime for low-light night photography on the Malecón
photography.goldenHourNotes: Puerto Vallarta offers exceptional golden hour conditions both sunrise and sunset due to ocean orientation and mountain backdrop. The western shoreline provides spectacular sunset photography with dramatic cliff formations catching warm light. Morning light along the Malecón and beaches creates soft, directional illumination ideal for architectural and street photography.

weather.seasonality: Puerto Vallarta has a distinct dry season from November through April with comfortable temperatures and minimal rainfall, followed by a warm, humid rainy season from June through September. May marks the shoulder season with heat building before the monsoons arrive.
weather.summary: The destination enjoys warm tropical weather year-round with average temperatures ranging from 24-31°C. The dry season offers perfect beach conditions with minimal rain, while the rainy season brings afternoon showers but lush landscapes and fewer tourists.

hotels.name: Casa Cupula
hotels.description: Charming beachfront guesthouse with colonial architecture, rooftop terrace, and easy access to Old Town restaurants and shops.

hotels.name: Hacienda Alemana
hotels.description: Boutique hotel featuring colonial-style rooms, private beach access, excellent restaurant, and personalized service in the heart of town.

hotels.name: Grand Palladium Vallarta Resort & Spa
hotels.description: All-inclusive luxury resort with beachfront location, multiple pools, world-class dining, spa facilities, and comprehensive entertainment options.
